# PLAN — iteration 2
## Current state assessment
Iteration 1 is the verified best: it passed the frozen simulation and routed timing gates, using 20 LUTs, 20 FFs, and 4 DSP48s. Since it is already timing-feasible, this iteration must reduce LUT use strictly to improve the `minimize_luts` objective; adding pipeline stages or changing handshake behavior is out of bounds.

## Hypothesis
Expressing each stage-1 pair sum as an explicitly sized unsigned sum-of-products may let Vivado absorb the add into DSP48 post-adder/cascade resources, reducing LUT use while preserving the two-stage pipeline.

## Instruction for generator
Replace the four separately declared product wires and the separate `input_sum01` / `input_sum23` additions with two explicitly 17-bit unsigned pair sum-of-products expressions, and apply `use_dsp = "yes"` to those pair expressions. Preserve the existing stage-1 registers, stage-2 addition and result register, valid/ready logic, synchronous reset behavior, and `// @latency 2`; ensure all product and pair-sum carries remain intact. This is a hypothesis: retain it only if the unchanged testbench passes, routed timing and metric-integrity gates pass, and routed LUT use is strictly below the incumbent’s 20.
